title: Little Raindrop Detail in Oppenheimer I haven’t seen people talk about

commenti.body:
My hometown’s theater operates as a non profit now, and local businesses like my father’s law firm can decide the movie for a given weekend by sponsoring it, so he chose Oppenheimer. Chatted with him today about it, and wouldn’t you know it he had reservations because he couldn’t see past the “titties in your face” as he put it. (He’s a Catholic deacon with an aversion to nudity. He got rid of cable when i was a toddler because A&E showed nudity in a rerun of I Claudius.) 

Thanks for your analysis, because I’m glad someone can rationalize and see the deeper meaning in a scene within its context outside of the fact that an actor was naked. Merry Christmas.

The connection to Jean is a good one. I didn’t catch that.

[But I talked a lot about the symbolism of the chain reaction](https://filmcolossus.com/movie-explanations/oppenheimer-2023) 

It’s a really cool moment because you can view the drops as bombs falling but also just as the general chain reaction of anything and everything that leads to the end of things. 

That and the deeper implications of the Bhagavad Gita were the two most interesting parts of the movie for me.
Hey I couldn't get past the titties in your face either, but I have no complaints
